decisions.statement: A window status present with a value other than allowed is capacity.
Both window statuses allowed is not capacity.
A rejected overage under allowed windows is not capacity.
Both window headers absent with an overage disabled reason is not capacity.
Both window headers absent with a body naming fast-mode credits is not capacity.
A window status header absent leaves the 429 unclassified.
One window header present and one absent is unclassified whatever the overage headers have.
The body is read only where both window headers are absent.
A header value is read with case folded away.
A header value that is blank is read as absent.
An unclassified 429 names the window headers that were absent.
Every class has a reason naming the values the headers held.
The body is matched for fast-mode credits by substring rather than by a parse.
Nothing here decides the answer to a 429.
Nothing here reads the account or the model the 429 came from.

definition: what a 429 from upstream says about capacity
